What Integrated Fridge-Freezer Door Fitting Involves

We fit and realign furniture panel doors on integrated fridge-freezers, including both single-door and twin-door configurations. Whether the door panel has detached, the hinge arm has worn out, or the door is no longer hanging true, we diagnose and fix the problem in a single visit.

Common Reasons Customers Book This Service

  • Hinge arm worn or broken on tall integrated unit
  • Door panel pulled off when appliance was accessed behind
  • Slider kit failed on frequently opened fridge door
  • New appliance installed without the furniture panel being rehung

Typical time on site: One to two hours.

Pricing for Integrated Fridge-Freezer Door Fitting in Rugby

Our integrated fridge-freezer door fitting service in Rugby starts from £50. The final price depends on the scope of work — number of units affected, whether replacement parts are required, and access within the property.

We always confirm the price before any work begins. For straightforward jobs where the scope is clear from the initial description, we will provide a fixed quote when you get in touch. For more complex situations where we need to assess on site first, we will quote a maximum price at the beginning of the visit and will not exceed it without your explicit agreement.

Kitchen Repairs in Rugby

Rugby has a varied housing stock from Victorian and Edwardian terraces and semis in the town centre to 1930s and post-war estates on the periphery, with newer developments around the town.

Rugby's mix of period and modern housing means our survey is particularly useful in confirming kitchen plans against actual room conditions.

Rugby's new-build estates to the east of the town frequently feature integrated appliance spaces and pre-routed plumbing that require careful checking against the kitchen plan before installation day, which our survey process specifically addresses.

If your fridge-freezer is also running noisily or not cooling efficiently, we can advise on whether the issue is installation-related — such as inadequate ventilation — as part of our visit.

Frequently Asked Questions

Yes — a door panel that hangs unevenly is almost always fixable. Common causes include a worn hinge arm, a loose mounting bracket, or the appliance itself not sitting level in the housing. We will check all components and adjust or replace as necessary to get the panel hanging perfectly level.

Yes — we regularly work on twin-door tall integrated units where both the fridge and freezer sections have separate furniture panel doors. We will set both doors to the correct height, ensuring they align with each other and with the surrounding cabinet doors.

Replacement hinge arms are available from the appliance manufacturer or from specialist kitchen hardware suppliers. If you can share the make, model, and year of your appliance, we can often source the correct part before the visit and carry out the repair in a single call-out.

Unfortunately yes — it is common for retailer installation teams to leave furniture panels unfitted, especially on tall integrated units where the door mounting requires careful adjustment. We specialise in exactly this type of remedial work and can usually complete the fitting within a day or two of your enquiry.
